facts.fact: ATC Uganda handed over Shs20.9 billion, its statutory 2% of gross annual revenue per the minister, to the Uganda Communications Commission for UCUSAF, which finances communication services in underserved areas; no event date is given, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: UCUSAF (Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund)
